en.quote: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod. And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
en.riddle: What is that in thine hand?
en.speaker: LORD

bonus_hint.quote: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהוָה מַה זֶּה בְיָדֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר מַטֶּֽה וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיַּשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיְהִי לְנָחָשׁ וַיָּנָס מֹשֶׁה מִפָּנָֽיו
he.speaker: יְהוָה

bonus_hint.quote: וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אִישׁ מַטֵּהוּ וַיִּהְיוּ לְתַנִּינִם וַיִּבְלַע מַטֵּֽה־אַהֲרֹן אֶת־מַטֹּתָֽם

en.2: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.
en.3: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

he.2: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהוָה מַה זֶּה בְיָדֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר מַטֶּֽה׃
he.3: וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיַּשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיְהִי לְנָחָשׁ וַיָּנָס מֹשֶׁה מִפָּנָֽיו׃
